title: 老板：在吗？
setting: Tuesday, 11:04 pm. You're in bed, nearly asleep.

giveup.zh: 明天一早，来我办公室一趟。
giveup.en: First thing tomorrow, come to my office.
You left your boss on read at midnight. Tomorrow starts in his office.

steps.narr: Tuesday, 11:04 pm. You're nearly asleep when your phone lights up.
steps.zh: 晚上十一点，你刚要睡着，手机亮了。

say.en: Reply politely: yes, you're here. Go ahead.
say.tip: 在的 is the polite 'yes, I'm here' (a bare 在 sounds curt). 您说 = go ahead, I'm listening.

mistakes.note: 再 (again) sounds just like 在 (here). 'I'm here' is 在.

ok.zh: 明天的会提前到早上八点
ok.en: Tomorrow's meeting has moved up to 8 am.

ok.zh: 方案你再改一下，七点半前发我
ok.en: Revise the proposal and send it to me before 7:30.

4.en: Reply politely: yes, you're here. Ask if he's still busy this late, then let him go ahead.
answers: 在的张总，这么晚还在忙啊？您说。
在的，这么晚了您还在忙？您说。
我在，张总这么晚还没睡啊？您请讲。
在的在的，您这么晚还在忙啊，您说！
4.gloss: Yes, Boss Zhang. Still busy this late? Go ahead.
4.tip: 这么晚还在忙啊？ = still busy this late? A little care before 您说 softens an 11 pm reply.

say.en: Got it: say you'll send it before half past seven.
answers: 好的，七点半之前发给您。
收到！明早七点半前发您。
say.gloss: Got it. I'll send it before 7:30.
say.tip: 收到 = got it, the standard reply to a boss. 发您 = send (it) to you. 前 or 之前 = before.

2.en: Got it: say you'll fix it right away.
2.gloss: Got it. I'll fix it right away.
2.tip: 收到 = got it, the standard reply to a boss. 马上 = right away. 改 = revise, fix.

4.en: Got it: promise it'll be with him before half past seven.
answers: 收到，您放心，七点半前保证发您。
好的，七点半前一定发给您，您放心！
收到！保证七点半之前发您。
没问题，您放心，七点半前给您。
4.gloss: Got it. Don't worry, you'll have it before 7:30, I promise.
4.tip: 您放心 = rest assured. 保证 = I promise (guaranteed): a deadline said with a promise.

steps.zh: 老婆，我今晚又得加班，你先睡吧
steps.en: Honey, I'm working late again tonight. Don't wait up.
That last one was sent by mistake.
You didn't see it, did you?

say.en: Reassure him: you didn't see a thing. Nothing at all.
answers: 没有没有，我啥也没看见。
say.gloss: Didn't see it. Didn't see a thing!
say.tip: 什么都没…… = didn't … anything at all. 啥也没看见 is the casual northern way to say it.

alts.gloss: Huh? I was asleep just now.

then.zh: 你一秒钟前还在回我消息
then.en: You were replying to me one second ago.

2.tip: 没看到 = didn't see (it). 怎么了？ = what's up? (All innocence.)

4.en: Reassure him: you didn't see a thing, and anyway, your lips are sealed.
answers: 您放心，我什么都没看到，嘴很严的！
您放心，什么都没看到，我嘴严得很。
没看到没看到，我嘴巴很紧的！
什么都没看到，我也不会乱说的。
4.gloss: Don't worry, I didn't see a thing. And my lips are sealed!

answers: 啊？我刚睡醒，您发什么了？
不好意思，我刚才睡着了，怎么了？
啊？刚才睡着了，您说什么了？
alts.gloss: Huh? I've only just woken up. What did you send?

4.tip: 嘴严 = tight-lipped, good at keeping secrets. 什么都没…… = not … anything at all.

say.en: Wish him good night, politely: he should get some rest too.
say.gloss: OK, you get some rest too!
say.tip: 早点休息 = get some rest (literally, rest a bit early), the polite good night. 辛苦了 = thanks for all your hard work.

4.en: Wish him good night, politely: he should rest too. His health comes first.
answers: 好的，您也早点休息，身体要紧！
您也早点休息，别太累了，身体要紧。
好的张总，早点休息，注意身体！
4.gloss: OK, you get some rest too. Your health comes first!
4.tip: 身体要紧 = your health comes first (要紧 = what matters most): the caring good night to someone senior.

say.tip: 收到 again: the word every office worker can type in their sleep. 明白 = understood.

ok.en: But still send me the proposal.

4.en: Reply like a professional. Then try your luck: so the proposal can wait, right?
answers: 收到。那方案是不是就不用发了？
收到。那方案还要发您吗？
明白，那方案是不是不用交了？
好的收到，方案还照常发您吗？
4.gloss: Noted. So I don't need to send the proposal now, right?
4.tip: 是不是就不用……了？ = so I don't have to … any more, right? (hoping). 方案 = the proposal.

steps.en: The meeting is off. The deadline isn't. Welcome to office life.
